# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to leap 50' laterally or 20' vertically.
@@ 2
Allows caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level, and to take that
distance off the severity of any longer fall.
@@ 3
Allows caster to move up and down vertically 10' per round. The spell does not
provide a means for horizontal movement.
@@ 4
Caster becomes weightless, but has no magical movement control. Weight
gradually returns at the end of the duration.
@@ 5
Caster can take actions underwater as if on land.
@@ 6
As Levitation I, except caster can fly at a rate of 15' per round (i.e., 1
mph).
@@ 7
As Levitation I, except rate is 50' per round.
@@ 8
Caster can safely dive through the air up to 50' per level. At the end of the
dive, the caster must land in water that is deep enough for the dive (at least
2' of water per 50' dived).
@@ 10
Caster can merge into any solid, inanimate material. While merged, the caster
cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges from the material, he can
emerge from any side or face of the material. The caster cannot move “through”
material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet. The caster can
exit at any time up to 10 minutes per level.
@@ 11
As Fly I, except rate is 75' per round.
@@ 12
As Landing, except caster can land safely from any fall 99% of the time.
@@ 13
As Levitation I, except rate is 200' per round.
@@ 14
Caster can pass through any inanimate material up to 1' per level of the
caster; it takes 1 round to pass through 2'.
@@ 15
As Fly I, except rate is 300' per round.
@@ 17
As Merging, except caster can turn within the material and can see outside if
within 6'' of the surface.
@@ 20
As Great Merge, except caster can cast spells on himself while merged.
@@ 25
As above, except rate is 400' per round.
@@ 30
As Passing, except caster can pass through as much material as the duration
allows at a rate of 10' per round.
@@ 50
Caster may use the abilities of any one of the spells on this list each round.
